hero.summary_en: Ontario AGCO 2026 approved C-level meeting dates cover four physical tracks: Woodbine Mohawk Park, Woodbine Racetrack, Fort Erie and Ajax Downs. Canadian national racing-system coverage remains incomplete.
hero.summary_ja: カナダはOntario州AGCO承認2026年日程の4競馬場に限定したC級対応。Woodbine Mohawk、Woodbine、Fort Erie、Ajax Downsを対象とし、全国・全体系の網羅ではない。

paragraphs_en: The active production route is limited to Woodbine Mohawk Park within the reviewed Ontario Racing context.
Standardbred Canada remains a separate reviewed prototype and does not make this route countrywide.
paragraphs_ja: 稼働中productionルートは確認済みOntario Racing文脈のWoodbine Mohawk Parkに限定する。
Standardbred Canadaは別の確認済みprototypeとして残し、このルートを全国網羅とは扱わない。

calendar_guidance_en: Only reviewed 2026 AGCO-approved meeting days at four Ontario venues are automatic rank C; approved is not a final no-cancellation guarantee. No original PDF/third-party racecards, commercial database mirroring or 2027 guessing.
